jobs.title: Implementation Consultant, Emergency Operations
jobs.description:
**About First Due**



First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end\-to\-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Implementation Consultant, Emergency Operations**


**Location**: Remote \- US Only  

**Country**: United States  

**Department**: Professional Services  

**Reports To**: Manager, Implementation Consulting  

**Position Type**: Full\-Time  

**Salary**: $80,000



### **Job Summary:**



The Implementation Consultant, Emergency Operations owns the configuration, deployment, and customer enablement of First Due's field response and operations modules: Pre\-Planning, Responder, Hydrants, and Command. The role serves Core agencies in standard pairing with an Implementation Manager, provides on\-call complex\-configuration support to Essentials, and contributes to Enterprise engagements. These modules put First Due in the field and on the apparatus. The role demands working knowledge of fire ground operations, incident command, pre\-incident planning, and water supply, and the ability to configure mobile and map\-based tools that responders rely on during active incidents.



### **Key Responsibilities:**


#### **Module configuration and delivery**


* Configure Pre\-Planning, including occupancy and building records, hazards, tactical information, and pre\-incident plans aligned to NFPA 1620 practice.
* Configure Responder for mobile incident response, including unit response views, dispatch and AVL information, and field access to occupancy and pre\-plan data.
* Configure Hydrants, including hydrant inventory, flow testing records, and water supply data aligned to NFPA 291 practice.
* Configure Command for incident command and accountability, including tactical worksheets and on\-scene workflows.

#### **Project execution and product partnership**


* Partner with the assigned Implementation Manager to deliver milestones on plan, surfacing risks early.
* Maintain accurate project status, level\-of\-effort actuals, and configuration documentation in Rocketlane.
* Partner with Technical Services on CAD and AVL data flows relevant to Responder and Command.
* Surface product gaps, defects, and enhancement requests for the cluster to the Team Manager and Product organization.

### **Qualifications:**


* Three or more years of customer\-facing implementation, configuration, or professional services experience in a SaaS environment, or equivalent operational experience in a fire or public safety agency.
* Strong public safety industry knowledge, including fire ground operations, incident command structures, pre\-incident planning, and water supply.
* Demonstrated working knowledge of field response workflows and the operational contexts in which mobile response tools are used.
* Familiarity with GIS and mapping concepts as applied to occupancies, hydrants, and response data.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent customer projects.
* Excellent communication, training delivery, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience with Rocketlane or a comparable professional services delivery platform.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**


* Direct experience as a firefighter, company officer, training officer, or fire service GIS or pre\-planning coordinator.
* Working knowledge of NFPA 1620 (pre\-incident planning) and NFPA 291 (fire flow testing and hydrant marking).
* Experience with GIS platforms, or with mobile data terminal and field\-response applications.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce, including account data hygiene and project handoff from sales.
* PMP, ITIL, or equivalent professional certification.
**For US\-based Roles**  

All applicants must be authorized to work for any US employer in the United States. Locality Media LLC is unable to sponsor or transition sponsorship ownership of employment visas at this time. Hiring is contingent upon candidates successfully passing a criminal background check. As part of the I\-9 verification of authorization to work in the US, Locality Media participates in E\-Verify.  

  

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**  

This role is fully remote with minimal travel expectations at this time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified employees and applicants to perform the essential functions as outlined above. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please reach out to people@firstdue.com.  

  

**Working at First Due**  

First Due offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package for eligible employees, including competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage, FSA/HSA, 401(k), flexible PTO, a fully remote workplace, a technology stipend, opportunities for advancement, and other benefits and perks that sets our team apart. Visit www.firstdue.com to learn more.  

  

If you are a resident of a state requiring wage transparency, please reach out to people@firstdue.com for a reasonable estimate of annual base compensation and any eligible incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered to successful candidates for roles may be higher or lower, based on non\-discriminatory criteria including but not limited to relevant professional experience, geographic location, knowledge, skills, and abilities. *This range will be reviewed on a regular basis.*  

  

First Due is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status or class. We are committed to promoting an environment of respect, acceptance, diversity and inclusivity, and equal opportunity. Discrimination and harassment of any type in any form will not be tolerated.  

  

When you apply for a role at Locality Media, LLC d/b/a First Due, we collect personal information such as identifiers (e.g., name, email, phone number), professional and employment information, education information, and information you provide in your application materials. We use this information to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you, and manage our recruiting process. We may share this information with our service providers who assist with recruiting and background screening. We do not sell or share applicant personal information for cross\-context behavioral advertising. We retain applicant information in accordance with our data retention policies. California residents have rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the CPRA. For more information, please review our Candidate Privacy.

jobs.title: EHR Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:
**POSITION TITLE:** EHR Support Specialist

**FLSA CLASSIFICATION:** Non\-Exempt

**Position Flexibility: Onsite:** This is an onsite position with possible limited remote work option.


**POSITION OVERVIEW:** The Electronic Health Record Support Specialist assists with accurate, efficient, and compliant use of the agency electronic health record (EHR) system. The position maintains EHR information and documentation tools, monitors documentation workflows and quality, provides routine user support and training, and assists with system testing, reporting, and implementation activities.


**ESSENTIAL POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Core Job Functions \& Essential Tasks**

* Enters, updates, and maintains information and other assigned data within the EHR.
* Builds and maintains electronic forms, templates, assessments, and documentation tools within the EHR.
* Updates forms and workflows to reflect regulatory, payer, agency, and operational changes; documents changes and tests functionality before deployment.
* Monitors documentation workflows for completeness, missing information, and required documentation.

**Administrative \& Operational Support**

* Generates routine reports and import/export files to assist with data, quality, and compliance initiatives.
* Maintains EHR documentation manuals, training resources, records, and other system documentation.
* Supports user\-account maintenance and password resets within assigned access and security protocols.
* Assists with maintaining accurate information and documentation practices consistent with agency policy, payer requirements, CARF standards, HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, and applicable regulations.

**Requests, Service \& Responsiveness**

* Serves as the first point of contact for EHR questions and assists users with navigating system issues.
* Troubleshoots basic EHR issues and appropriately escalates technical, privacy, or security concerns.
* Provides introductory EHR training as well as training on workflows and documentation standards.
* Develops quick\-reference guides, job aids, and training materials for users of varying computer proficiency.

**Projects \& Special Assignments**

* Assists with testing new EHR functionality, forms, templates, and workflows before implementation.
* Participates in EHR implementation projects and supports deployment of new features and processes.
* Collaborates with departments to improve documentation efficiency and reinforce agency standards.

**Departmental \& Organizational Support**

* Notifies staff of documentation deficiencies and supports timely follow\-up and correction processes.
* Attends meetings related to EHR use, data and documentation, workflows, and system implementation.
* Supports MHA’s mission through accurate records, responsive service, confidentiality, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Complies with HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, payer, and regulatory requirements.
* Completes other duties and special assignments as requested by the EHR Administrator.

**ORGANIZATION STANDARDS:**

**Professionalism and Communication**


Demonstrates clear, respectful, and professional communication in both verbal and written interactions, with a focus on collaboration and solution\-oriented dialogue. Shares information responsibly and addresses concerns constructively while maintaining a positive, professional demeanor—even in challenging situations.

**Time \& Priority Management**


Effectively manages workload by prioritizing tasks, planning proactively, and addressing challenges to meet deadlines and responsibilities. Maintains a solution\-focused approach and professional composure while balancing competing priorities.

**Reliability \& Accountability \& Ownership**


Demonstrates dependability by consistently meeting commitments, deadlines, and responsibilities while taking ownership of work and outcomes. Acts with integrity, follows through on obligations, and addresses mistakes proactively to support a culture of accountability and trust.

**Adaptability and Change Agility**


Demonstrates adaptability by embracing new processes, priorities, and organizational changes with resilience and a willingness to learn. Adjusts work approaches as needed and supports others through change with a constructive, solution\-focused mindset.

**Organizational Alignment and Mission Focus**


Demonstrates behaviors aligned with the organization’s mission, values, and professional standards while supporting goals and initiatives through actions and attitude. Consistently follows policies and ethical guidelines, maintains confidentiality, and contributes to a culture of professionalism, respect, and service.


Requirements:

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS:**

* High school diploma/GED required; relevant associate degree preferred.
* One year of administrative, healthcare, or customer\-service experience preferred.
* EHR experience preferred; Netsmart MyEvolv or behavioral health EHR experience strongly preferred.
* Basic EHR knowledge to develop electronic forms, templates, tools, and workflow configurations.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, organization, problem solving, communication, time management.
* Microsoft Office proficiency with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

**Driver Level:** Level 3 – Occasional driving for meetings, training, or non\-routine sites. License not required, reliable transportation required, legal use of transportation when driving for work purposes.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Prolonged sitting, viewing a computer monitor, keyboarding, and use of standard office equipment.
* Occasional standing, walking, bending, lifting or carrying office up to twenty\-five (25\) pounds.
* Reliable transportation and occasional travel to meetings, training, or non\-routine sites as required.


All the above duties and responsibilities are considered essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. All job requirements listed indicate the minimum level of knowledge, skills and/or ability deemed necessary to perform the job proficiently. This job description is not to be construed as a detailed statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements. Employees may be required to perform any other job\-related instructions as requested by their supervisors, subject to reasonable accommodation.

jobs.title: Change Management Specialist (Slack Implementation)
jobs.description:
**Change Management Specialist (Slack Implementation)**

**Federal Agency Slack Rollout**

**Pay:** $130,000\.00 – $135,000\.00 per year

Full\-Time \| Remote (occasional in\-person as needed)

**About Us**

At Kavant Solutions, our mission is to support federal, state, and local government organizations with high\-quality IT services rooted in security, innovation, and accountability. We work alongside public sector leaders to advance modernization initiatives, strengthen operational resilience, and deliver measurable results for the communities they serve.

**About the Role**

Kavant is leading the implementation of Slack as the new enterprise collaboration platform for a large federal agency, and we're looking for a hands\-on Change Management Specialist to drive the people side of this rollout day to day. This isn't a support role bolted onto an IT project — you'll be in the details, building and executing the plans, materials, and touchpoints that help thousands of federal employees move off legacy communication tools and adopt Slack with confidence.

You'll work hand\-in\-hand with Delivery and Program Management to keep change activities synced to the Slack implementation timeline, and directly with agency leadership, program offices, and end users to build sponsorship, communication, training, and — critically — a rollout that gets people genuinely excited to use Slack instead of falling back on email and other legacy channels.

**What You'll Do**

Change Strategy \& Planning

* Develop a comprehensive organizational change management (OCM) plan for the Slack rollout, aligned to the implementation timeline from kickoff through post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Conduct stakeholder analysis and change impact assessments across program offices, regional teams, and end\-user groups to understand current communication habits and workflows.
* Apply structured change methodologies (e.g., Prosci ADKAR, Kotter's 8\-Step Process) to shape the overall change approach for the Slack transition.
* Define success metrics for Slack adoption — active usage, channel engagement, migration off legacy tools — and build a measurement plan to track them pre\- and post\-launch.

Rollout Planning \& Execution

* Design a phased Slack rollout plan (pilot group, wave\-based deployment by office/division, or agency\-wide launch) tailored to the agency's structure, risk tolerance, and operational calendar.
* Build a detailed go\-live playbook covering workspace/channel structure decisions, readiness checkpoints, cutover communications, hypercare support, and contingency/rollback plans.
* Coordinate rollout logistics with Delivery and Program Management to keep change activities synchronized with technical milestones (workspace provisioning, integrations, data migration, UAT, etc.).
* Establish a command\-center/hypercare model for the go\-live window, including escalation paths for user issues and Slack\-specific troubleshooting.

Stakeholder Engagement \& Communications

* Develop and execute a multi\-channel communication plan tailored to distinct audiences — executive sponsors, program managers, front\-line staff, and IT support teams — explaining what Slack is, why it's replacing current tools, and what's changing for them.
* Support agency sponsors and leadership in visible, active sponsorship, including drafting talking points and town hall materials that model using Slack themselves.
* Build a change agent/champion network embedded across offices and divisions — often Slack's earliest and most active users — to extend reach, gather ground\-level feedback, and reinforce adoption.
* Create a project narrative and key messaging framework that clearly answers "what's changing, why Slack, and what's in it for me" for every stakeholder group.

Marketing \& Branding for the Rollout

* Develop an internal campaign name, visual identity, and launch concept for the Slack rollout (e.g., a memorable internal name, logo, and tagline) to build recognition and reduce "just another government system" fatigue.
* Design a pre\-launch teaser campaign (countdown emails, posters/digital signage for agency locations, intranet banners) to build anticipation ahead of go\-live.
* Produce a consistent visual toolkit — templates for emails, slide decks, digital signage, and printed materials, plus in\-Slack assets (welcome messages, channel banners, emoji/branding) — so every touchpoint reinforces the same look, tone, and message.
* Plan launch\-day and launch\-week engagement moments (kickoff event, leadership video message, Slack\-based scavenger hunts or challenges, swag/recognition for early adopters, etc.) appropriate for a federal agency environment.
* Maintain an internal "hub" (SharePoint site, intranet page, or a dedicated Slack channel) as the single source of truth for FAQs, training resources, and rollout updates.

Training \& Adoption

* Design a tiered training strategy (role\-based training, train\-the\-trainer, self\-paced e\-learning, live workshops) to build end\-user proficiency on Slack — channels, messaging etiquette, integrations, and search.
* Develop job aids, quick\-reference guides, video walkthroughs, and other adoption support materials tailored to Slack's features and the agency's approved use cases.
* Coordinate a training delivery schedule aligned to each rollout wave, including scheduling, room/platform logistics, and attendance tracking.
* Track and report Slack adoption and utilization metrics before and after go\-live, and adjust training/support based on gaps.

Resistance Management \& Readiness

* Conduct organizational readiness assessments ahead of each go\-live milestone.
* Identify sources of resistance (workflow disruption, skill gaps, cultural/procedural friction) and design targeted mitigation strategies.
* Support agency leadership in addressing adoption barriers as they surface, including facilitated feedback sessions with resistant groups.

Program \& Client Management

* Serve as the day\-to\-day change management point of contact for the agency engagement.
* Coordinate with Delivery and Program Management to align change activities with technical implementation milestones.
* Report on change management progress, risks, and adoption metrics to both Kavant leadership and client stakeholders on a regular cadence.

Business Development Support

* Support proposal development and discovery conversations when future opportunities include change management scope, in coordination with the Growth Lead.
* Provide OCM\-specific input on estimates, staffing, and work plans for relevant proposals, drawing on lessons learned from this engagement.

Professional Expectations

* General office hours are Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm, with willingness to work outside those hours for deadlines, go\-live events, and time\-sensitive matters.
* Maintain a professional, respectful, and solution\-oriented approach in all interactions.
* Communicate proactively about priorities, progress, risks, and blockers; raise concerns early.
* Respond to emails, messages, and requests within 24 business hours.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and follow through on commitments.
* Demonstrate initiative by identifying opportunities for improvement and bringing forward solutions.
* Protect confidential client, employee, contract, and company information at all times.

**Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of experience in organizational change management, ideally supporting government or public sector technology implementations.
* Direct experience supporting a Slack rollout or similar collaboration\-platform implementation (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace) strongly preferred.
* Certification in a recognized change management methodology (e.g., Prosci Change Management Certification, ACMP Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP), or equivalent) strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience applying structured change frameworks (ADKAR, Kotter's 8\-Step, Bridges' Transition Model, or similar) to technology or process implementations.
* Experience developing and executing stakeholder communication plans, training strategies, and adoption measurement approaches.
* Experience building internal marketing/branding campaigns for a system launch or major organizational initiative is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with federal or state government environments and the change dynamics specific to public sector organizations — civil service culture, procurement cycles, and multi\-layered stakeholder approval.
* Strong facilitation and executive\-communication skills; comfortable coaching senior agency sponsors.
* Working knowledge of Slack (channels, workspaces, integrations, admin settings) is required; familiarity with additional workplace and IT tools (e.g., Tableau, SharePoint, MS Teams) is a plus for supporting communication, reporting, and adoption tracking.
* PMP, Prosci, or CCMP certification a plus.

**Benefits**

* 401(k)
* 401 (k) matching
* Paid Time Off

**Work Location:** Remote, with occasional in\-person presence needed (Washington, DC area)

Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year
